title: Deploy CoachConnect to Railway
description: Deploy backend/ and frontend/ as two Railway services from the GitHub repo. Needs: persistent volume on backend for SQLite db + WhatsApp session, env vars set in Railway dashboard, nginx.conf made host/port-configurable (Railway private networking instead of docker-compose's automatic 'backend' DNS name).

title: Scaffold frontend: React + Vite UI
description: Clean UI covering: login, connect-WhatsApp (QR display + status), schools/groups management, message templates (with AI draft helper), schedule builder, sent log, Send Now broadcast button. Talks to the Express API.
close_reason: React+Vite frontend scaffolded: login, dashboard with WhatsApp QR/status + Send Now, schools, templates (with AI draft helper), schedule builder, sent log. Builds clean with vite build.

title: Scaffold backend: Express + Prisma/SQLite + whatsapp-web.js
description: API and logic layer: auth (single admin user, JWT cookie), schools/groups CRUD, templates CRUD, schedule CRUD, sent-message log, whatsapp-web.js service (QR connect, status, send), node-cron scheduler with staggered sends, AI draft endpoint calling Claude using the draft-message skill's rules as system prompt.
close_reason: Express+Prisma/SQLite backend scaffolded: auth (single admin seeded from env), schools/templates/schedule CRUD, whatsapp-web.js service (QR/status/send), node-cron scheduler with staggered sends, AI draft endpoint reusing draft-message skill as system prompt, sent-message log, Dockerfile

title: Build CoachConnect Step 3 web app (frontend + backend)
description: Move from Step 2 (Make.com/Sheets proof) to Step 3 of planning.md: a real web app with login, WhatsApp QR connection, school/group management, message templates, scheduling, sent log, plus Step 4 extras (AI draft helper, Send Now). Stack: React+Vite frontend, Node/Express+Prisma/SQLite backend, whatsapp-web.js for the WhatsApp layer, Claude API for AI drafting (reusing the draft-message skill's tone rules).
close_reason: Full scaffold complete: backend (Express/Prisma/SQLite/whatsapp-web.js) and frontend (React/Vite) built, installed, and smoke-tested (build passes, migration applies, server boots, auth+CRUD endpoints verified end-to-end). Real WhatsApp QR connection still needs Maroof to scan with the spare SIM phone.

title: Get NIETE approval before expanding to all coaches
description: Present the working CoachConnect automation to NIETE management and get sign-off before Step 5 (opening the platform to other coaches). Required because it involves teacher data and organisational cost.

title: Deploy readiness: Docker, env config, README for CoachConnect app
description: docker-compose for frontend+backend, .env.example files, top-level README/setup doc so the app is ready to run locally or deploy to any Docker host.
close_reason: docker-compose.yml + per-service Dockerfiles (backend installs system chromium for whatsapp-web.js; frontend builds static + nginx reverse-proxies /api), .env.example, README setup instructions for local dev and Docker deploy.

title: Create .claude/skills/ with reusable skills for agents
description: No skills/ folder exists. The three SKILL.md files (root, notes/, instructions/) are directory documentation, not invokable Claude Code skills. Extract genuinely reusable logic currently duplicated only inside agent definitions into real skills: draft-message (warm WhatsApp message tone/format rules, currently only inside message-drafter agent) and log-decision (decisions.md entry format, referenced by notes/SKILL.md and session-closer but not formalized anywhere).
close_reason: Backfilled decisions.md with entries 4-6; created .claude/skills/draft-message and .claude/skills/log-decision, wired agents to reference them, updated folder-structure docs

title: Log missing decisions in decisions.md
description: decisions.md hasn't been updated since commit 2d8867e. Two real structural decisions since then were never logged: (1) adding SKILL.md context files + three agent definitions (commit a98f8fa), (2) renaming feedback_loop.md to agent_loop.md (commits b943d73/7658a02). Per notes/SKILL.md convention, every structural change gets a numbered decision entry.
close_reason: Backfilled decisions.md with entries 4-6; created .claude/skills/draft-message and .claude/skills/log-decision, wired agents to reference them, updated folder-structure docs

title: Build the message schedule in Google Sheets
description: Create a Google Sheet with columns for school group, message text, day, and time. This becomes the single source of truth for what gets sent when, and is read by Make.com in Step 2.

title: Get a spare SIM and add it to all 9 school WhatsApp groups
description: Buy a cheap second SIM to use as the dedicated CoachConnect number. Add it to all 9 NIETE school groups so automated messages can be sent safely without risking the personal number.

title: Try Make.com automation with Google Sheet
description: Set up a Make.com scenario that reads from a Google Sheet and sends a WhatsApp message to one school group. This proves the no-code automation works before building the full app.

title: Write message templates for each occasion
description: Draft warm, human-sounding templates for the three core message types: Monday motivation, session reminder (day before), and thank-you follow-up (day after). Store them in the Google Sheet.
